notes.title: Now Available in English and Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that
"A 20-year-old RPG Maker game remade with the latest RPG MAKER UNITE and available for free?! ~The Heroes of the RPG Maker series vs. the Demon Lord~"
now supports English and Simplified Chinese!

Now it's even easier for our friends overseas to enjoy the game—
so be sure to check it out!

※ The game language is automatically selected based on your Steam Launcher language settings.
Please make sure to check your Steam language before launching the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2788440
